requirements.evidence: stageSize(n,ℓ)=ceil(n/2^ℓ). Writing m=stageSize(n,ℓ+1), s=stageSize(n,ℓ), stage pairs k and k+m when k<m and k+m<s, multiplies their sum by 1+δ(ℓ,k,c), and copies unpaired entries unchanged. This is the paper algorithm under zero-based indexing. Inactive positions are zeroed but never used as available partners. computed returns position 0 after depth(n) stages. The recurrence is an actual definition, not an abstract choice.

requirements.evidence: The final target explicitly states |Δx(i,c)|≤gamma(depth(n),u)|x(i,c)| for every i∈Fin n and every coordinate c, with gamma(d,u)=d*u/(1-d*u). depth(n) is the least d with n≤2^d for positive n, so the bound has exactly the requested ceiling-logarithm constant. The hypothesis d*u<1 makes its denominator positive. n=1 is covered with d=0 and zero perturbation bound.
